parameters.description: Only companies of these legal forms, such as 5710 (SAS, including SASU), 5499 (SARL, including EURL), 1000 (sole trader) or 9220 (declared association). The list has every form INSEE uses.

parameters.description: Only companies with an establishment in these departments, overseas ones included.
parameters.name: departments

parameters.description: Only companies with an establishment in these regions.

parameters.name: commune_codes

parameters.description: Keep to associations, or leave them out. Both unless you choose.
parameters.name: associations

parameters.description: Only companies holding every label or registration chosen, such as RGE for energy renovation work or Qualiopi for funded training.
parameters.name: labels

parameters.description: Only companies with staff under this collective agreement, by its 4 digit IDCC number.

parameters.description: Only companies run by someone with this last name: a director, an officer, or a local authority's elected official.

parameters.description: Narrow the person by birth date. The register publishes the month only, so the day is ignored.

parameters.description: Whether the person runs a company or sits on a local council. Either unless you choose.

parameters.name: revenue_min

parameters.description: Only companies whose latest published revenue is at most this many euros.
parameters.name: revenue_max

parameters.description: Only companies whose latest published net income is at least this many euros. Use a negative number for a loss.
parameters.name: net_income_min

parameters.description: Only companies whose latest published net income is at most this many euros. 0 finds the loss making ones.
parameters.name: net_income_max

parameters.description: Best match first, or favour the companies with the most establishments among the matches for 'Search for'. Searches on filters alone always list the largest first.
parameters.name: order

parameters.description: How many of each company's matching establishments to return. 10 unless you change it.

description: Search the French government's official directory of companies, the Annuaire des Entreprises: every company, association and public body registered in France. Find businesses by name, address, director, activity code, legal form, department, region, number of employees, labels such as RGE or Qualiopi, and revenue; look one up by SIREN or SIRET; or find the companies near a place. Results include the legal form, head office, directors, latest accounts and VAT number. No account or API key required.
